title: Moving Up a Project Deadline
summaryZh: 客戶臨時將展示日期提前，團隊討論工作進度、分工和可交付範圍。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Did you see the client's email this morning?
sentences.zh: 你看到客戶今天早上的電子郵件了嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes. They want to move the demo from Friday to Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 看到了。他們想把展示從星期五提前到星期三。
sentences.note: move something up 表示把日期或時間提前。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Can we get the new dashboard ready by then?
sentences.zh: 我們能在那之前把新版儀表板準備好嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: The desktop screens are done, but the mobile layout needs another day.
sentences.zh: 桌面版畫面完成了，但手機版版面還需要一天。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Let's focus on the desktop demo and finish the mobile version later.
sentences.zh: 我們先專注在桌面版展示，之後再完成手機版。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That would help, but the charts still need the final sales numbers.
sentences.zh: 那會有幫助，但圖表仍需要最終銷售數字。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I'll ask the finance team to send them by noon today.
sentences.zh: 我會請財務團隊在今天中午前把數字傳來。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: If the numbers arrive today, can you finish the charts tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 如果數字今天到，你能在明天完成圖表嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, but I need someone else to check the labels and copy.
sentences.zh: 可以，但我需要別人幫忙檢查標籤和文案。
sentences.note: copy 在設計和行銷工作中常指畫面上的文案。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Nina can review the copy while you build the charts.
sentences.zh: 你製作圖表時，Nina 可以同時檢查文案。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Good. I can send a complete draft by three on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 好。我可以在星期二三點前送出完整草稿。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Let's review it together at four and list any final changes.
sentences.zh: 我們四點一起檢查，並列出最後需要修改的地方。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Should I tell the client the mobile version will follow on Friday?
sentences.zh: 我要告訴客戶手機版會在星期五補上嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yes. Make it clear that Wednesday's demo will be desktop only.
sentences.zh: 要。請清楚說明星期三只展示桌面版。
sentences.note: make it clear that 表示把某件事說清楚。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Understood. I'll update the project plan after this meeting.
sentences.zh: 了解。我會在會議後更新專案計畫。

questions.q: Why does the team need a new plan?
options: The client moved the demo to Wednesday
The designer is taking Friday off

questions.q: Who will review the labels and copy?
What will the team show on Wednesday?
